bio.text: Anastasia "Stacey" Travers is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 12; she assumed office on January 9, 2023.
She was born in Athens, Greece, served in the U.S. Army as a Russian intelligence interceptor, and earned a B.S. in geosciences from the University of Arizona in Tucson.
Her career experience includes working as a radio producer for the BBC.
She advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
